experiments.name: Coach Cold Outreach — Free Report Offer
experiments.description: Contact 20 career coaches via LinkedIn or email with a personalized offer: 'I'll generate a free white-label automation defense report for one of your clients. You keep it, branded with your logo. No strings attached.' Measure response rate, acceptance rate, and willingness to pay for more.

metrics.secondary: Acceptance rate of free report (target: >30% of responses)
metrics.tertiary: Willingness to pay for more reports (target: >25% of those who receive free report)

stop_conditions: If 0 responses after 50 outreach messages → STOP, reposition
If >50% respond but 0 accept free report → product-market messaging gap, not product gap
If >50% accept free report but 0 willing to pay → pricing or proof gap

experiments.name: Coach Demo Video — LinkedIn Content Test
experiments.description: Create a 3-minute demo video showing: (1) searching an occupation, (2) generating a white-label report with custom branding, (3) showing O*NET source citations in the report. Post on LinkedIn with hashtag #careercoaching. Measure views, engagement, and inbound inquiries from coaches.
stop_conditions: If 0 inbound inquiries after 1000 views → messaging or product-market fit issue
If high views but 0 engagement → content quality issue, not product issue

experiments.name: O*NET Source Citation A/B Test
experiments.description: In the coach cold outreach (EXP-001), A/B test two versions of the outreach message: Version A emphasizes 'O*NET 30.3 government data grounding' and Version B emphasizes 'AI-powered analysis'. Measure which version gets higher response and acceptance rates.

metrics.primary: Response rate difference between A and B (target: A > B by >10%)

stop_conditions: If no difference between A and B → O*NET grounding may not be a perceived differentiator by coaches
If B > A → coaches may not value government data sourcing as expected

experiments.name: SEO Organic Traffic Baseline
experiments.description: Submit sitemap to Google Search Console. Track organic impressions and clicks for /automation-risk/:slug pages over 30 days. Measure which occupation pages get impressions and what queries drive them.
stop_conditions: If 0 impressions after 30 days → sitemap indexing issue or domain authority too low
If impressions but 0 clicks → title/meta description optimization needed
